name: Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products
old_description: The Kobe Steel Group (KOBELCO) established operations as Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products (KAAP) in Bowling Green, Kentucky, in 2005.  Since then, KAAP has undergone six facility expansions, adding equipment and expertise necessary to become a leader in forged aluminum suspension products.  Over time, KAAP established itself as a global leader in forged aluminum technology for the automotive industry.
about:
Kobelco Aluminum Automotive Products (KAAP) was established in Bowling Green, Kentucky, in 2005 as the U.S. operating arm of Japan's Kobe Steel Group, known globally under the KOBELCO brand. The facility began as a greenfield site and has since undergone six expansions to support its focus on forged aluminum components.

The company produces aluminum forgings for automotive suspension systems and cast rods for compressors, serving global automakers from its Kentucky plant. Its capabilities include advanced engineering, forging, and casting processes, with the expansions adding equipment and technical expertise to handle high-volume production.

KAAP's customer base includes major automotive manufacturers such as Honda, Nissan, and Subaru, as evidenced by multiple quality awards from these OEMs. The company supplies the broader automotive industry worldwide, with a focus on lightweight suspension components that contribute to fuel efficiency.

KAAP's stated mission, "Sei shin sei i" (put your heart and soul into your work), underpins its emphasis on safety, quality, and environmental responsibility. The company highlights that its aluminum forged products reduce vehicle weight, lower fuel consumption, and cut carbon emissions, aligning with industry demands for sustainability.
